pages.text: The Awakening Altar is a crafting structure that is $(bold)usually$() used to create $(l:elemental/awakened_supremium)Awakened Supremium$(). The structure consists of 1 Infusion Altar, 4 Infusion Pedestals and 4 $(l:elemental/essence_vessel)Essence Vessels$(). $(br2)Once you have a recipe put in place, you just need to activate the altar with a Redstone signal.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Placing the Awakening Altar in world will show you where to place your pedestals and vessels.
